title: Weekly planning and manufacturing requirements
description: Demand forecasts and inventory policies support supply recommendations, which feed material requirements and rough-cut capacity planning.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Weekly planning and manufacturing requirements
    accDescr: Demand forecasts and inventory policies support supply recommendations, which feed material requirements and rough-cut capacity planning.
    DF[Demand Forecast]
    IP[Inventory Policy]
    SPR[Supply Plan Recommendation]
    MRP[Material Requirement Plan]
    RCCP[Rough Cut Capacity Plan]

    DF -. Item and warehouse; relevant weekly bucket .-> SPR
    IP -. Item and warehouse; active policy and driver .-> SPR
    SPR --> MRP
    SPR --> RCCP

title: Manufacturing recipe and routing records
description: An item links to its bill of material and routing. Routing operations identify work centers, whose calendars provide daily capacity.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Manufacturing recipe and routing records
    accDescr: An item links to its bill of material and routing. Routing operations identify work centers, whose calendars provide daily capacity.
    ITEM[Item]
    BOM[Bill of Material]
    RT[Routing]
    RTO[Routing Operation]
    WC[Work Center]
    WCC[Work Center Calendar]

    ITEM --> BOM
    ITEM --> RT --> RTO --> WC --> WCC

title: Work-order release and daily operation schedules
description: A supply recommendation supports a work order and its operations. Daily schedules match work-center calendar records on both center and date.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Work-order release and daily operation schedules
    accDescr: A supply recommendation supports a work order and its operations. Daily schedules match work-center calendar records on both center and date.
    SPR[Supply Plan Recommendation]
    WO[Work Order]
    WOO[Work Order Operation]
    WOS[Work Order Operation Schedule]
    WCC[Work Center Calendar]

    SPR --> WO --> WOO --> WOS
    WCC -. WorkCenterID and CalendarDate equals ScheduleDate .-> WOS

title: Approved time and payroll-period support for the register
description: Approved time matches payroll by employee and period; labor allocations link through PayrollRegisterLine. PayrollPeriod identifies the register population.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Approved time and payroll-period support for the register
    accDescr: Approved time matches payroll by employee and period; labor allocations link through PayrollRegisterLine. PayrollPeriod identifies the register population.
    TCE[Time Clock Entry]
    LTE[Labor Time Entry]
    PP[Payroll Period]
    PR[Payroll Register]


    TCE -. EmployeeID and PayrollPeriodID; aggregate hours .-> PR
    TCE -->|TimeClockEntryID| LTE
    LTE -->|LaborTimeEntryID| LINE[PayrollRegisterLine]
    LINE -->|PayrollRegisterID| PR
    PP -->|PayrollPeriodID| PR

title: Recurring journal category and ledger accounts
description: A recurring category connects to its journal entry, ledger detail, and account.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Recurring journal category and ledger accounts
    accDescr: A recurring category connects to its journal entry, ledger detail, and account.
    RC[Recurring category]
    JE[JournalEntry]
    GL[GLEntry]
    AC[Account]

    RC --> JE --> GL --> AC

title: Factory overhead journals and manufacturing cost support
description: Factory overhead connects through journal entry and ledger detail to manufacturing costing support.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Factory overhead journals and manufacturing cost support
    accDescr: Factory overhead connects through journal entry and ledger detail to manufacturing costing support.
    FO[Factory Overhead]
    JE[JournalEntry]
    GL[GLEntry]
    MFG[Manufacturing costing support]

    FO --> JE --> GL --> MFG

title: Design work approved time and invoice evidence
description: A service order line leads to an engagement, staff assignments, approved time, monthly billing support, and an invoice line.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Design work approved time and invoice evidence
    accDescr: A service order line leads to an engagement, staff assignments, approved time, monthly billing support, and an invoice line.
    ORDER[Service order line] --> ENG[ServiceEngagement]
    ENG --> STAFF[ServiceEngagementAssignment]
    STAFF -->|ServiceEngagementAssignmentID| TIME[ServiceTimeEntry: approved hours]
    TIME -. Engagement and inclusive billing period; sum billable hours .-> BILL[ServiceBillingLine]
    BILL -->|SalesInvoiceLineID| INV[SalesInvoiceLine]

title: Customer demand and the service engagement
description: Customer and sales order connect through a service order line to its engagement.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Customer demand and the service engagement
    accDescr: Customer and sales order connect through a service order line to its engagement.
    C[Customer]
    SO[Sales Order]
    SOL[Service Order Line]
    ENG[Service Engagement]

    C --> SO --> SOL --> ENG

title: Service engagement staff and time evidence
description: An engagement leads to assignments and time entries. Employee records support both assignments and time.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Service engagement staff and time evidence
    accDescr: An engagement leads to assignments and time entries. Employee records support both assignments and time.
    ENG[Service Engagement]
    ASG[Assignments]
    TIME[Service Time Entry]
    EMP[Employee]

    ENG --> ASG --> TIME
    EMP --> ASG
    EMP --> TIME

title: Approved service time billing and settlement
description: Approved time is matched by engagement and the inclusive billing interval. A billing line stores its invoice-line key; the invoice header supplies the invoice key used by cash applications.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Approved service time billing and settlement
    accDescr: Approved time is matched by engagement and the inclusive billing interval. A billing line stores its invoice-line key; the invoice header supplies the invoice key used by cash applications.
    TIME[Approved Service Time]
    BILL[Service Billing Line]
    INV[Sales Invoice Line]
    CASH[Cash Application]

    TIME -. Engagement and inclusive billing dates; aggregate hours .-> BILL
    BILL -->|SalesInvoiceLineID| INV
    INV -->|SalesInvoiceID| HEADER[SalesInvoice]
    HEADER -->|SalesInvoiceID| CASH

title: Receipt-matched purchase evidence
description: Requisition connects to a purchase-order line, goods-receipt line, supplier-invoice line and header, then disbursement.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Receipt-matched purchase evidence
    accDescr: Requisition connects to a purchase-order line, goods-receipt line, supplier-invoice line and header, then disbursement.
    REQ[PurchaseRequisition] --> PO[PurchaseOrderLine]
    PO --> REC[GoodsReceiptLine]
    REC --> BILL[PurchaseInvoiceLine]
    BILL --> HEADER[PurchaseInvoice]
    HEADER --> PAY[DisbursementPayment]

title: Forecast and policy support a purchase request
description: Demand forecast and inventory policy feed a supply-plan recommendation that supports a purchase requisition.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Forecast and policy support a purchase request
    accDescr: Demand forecast and inventory policy feed a supply-plan recommendation that supports a purchase requisition.
    DF[Demand Forecast]
    IP[Inventory Policy]
    SPR[Supply Plan Recommendation]
    PR[Purchase Requisition]

    DF -. Item and warehouse; relevant weekly bucket .-> SPR
    IP -. Item and warehouse; active policy and driver .-> SPR
    SPR -->|SupplyPlanRecommendationID| PR

title: Purchase request order and receipt
description: Solid arrows label stored requisition and purchase-order-line keys. Headers supply document context through their line keys.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Purchase request order and receipt
    accDescr: Solid arrows label stored requisition and purchase-order-line keys. Headers supply document context through their line keys.
    PR[Purchase Requisition]
    PO[PurchaseOrderLine]
    GR[GoodsReceiptLine]

    PR -->|RequisitionID| PO
    PO -->|POLineID| GR

title: Goods sale and customer settlement records
description: An order leads to shipment and invoice records. A separate cash receipt passes through an application to the invoice.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Goods sale and customer settlement records
    accDescr: An order leads to shipment and invoice records. A separate cash receipt passes through an application to the invoice.
    SO[SalesOrder and SalesOrderLine] --> SH[Shipment and ShipmentLine]
    SH --> SI[SalesInvoice and SalesInvoiceLine]
    CR[CashReceipt] --> APP[CashReceiptApplication]
    APP -->|Applied to| SI

title: Pricing support for the sales order
description: Customer and item context connects through price lists, promotions, and override approval to a sales order.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Pricing support for the sales order
    accDescr: Customer and item context connects through price lists, promotions, and override approval to a sales order.
    CTX[Customer and Item Context]
    PL[Price List]
    PROMO[Promotion Program]
    OVR[Price Override Approval]
    SO[Sales Order]

    CTX --> PL --> SO
    CTX --> PROMO --> SO
    CTX --> OVR --> SO

title: Available inventory and backordered quantity
description: A sales order reaches available finished goods. Enough stock proceeds to shipment and invoice; short stock leads through backordered quantity to a later shipment.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Available inventory and backordered quantity
    accDescr: A sales order reaches available finished goods. Enough stock proceeds to shipment and invoice; short stock leads through backordered quantity to a later shipment.
    SOL[Sales Order]
    FG[Available Finished Goods]
    BO[Backordered Quantity]
    SHL[Later Shipment]
    SIL[Later Sales Invoice]

    SOL --> FG
    FG -->|Enough stock| SHL --> SIL
    FG -->|Short stock| BO --> SHL

title: Credit memo and remaining customer credit
description: The solid arrow identifies the original-invoice key. Dashed arrows describe accounting allocation and conditional later refund chronology, not database joins.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Credit memo and remaining customer credit
    accDescr: The solid arrow identifies the original-invoice key. Dashed arrows describe accounting allocation and conditional later refund chronology, not database joins.
    INV[Original Sales Invoice]
    CM[Credit Memo]
    CC[Customer Credit]
    RF[Customer Refund]

    INV -->|OriginalSalesInvoiceID on memo| CM
    CM -. Reduces remaining AR when present .-> INV
    CM -. Excess credit after AR allocation .-> CC
    CC -. Later refund if paid out .-> RF

title: Local dataset build from settings to exported teaching files
description: Settings initialize the generation context, tables and master data precede operating activity, and accounting postings and year-end close precede validation, anomaly injection and file exports. This documents the local generator workflow; classroom users begin with the published files.
notation:
flowchart LR
    accTitle: Local dataset build from settings to exported teaching files
    accDescr: Settings initialize the generation context, tables and master data precede operating activity, and accounting postings and year-end close precede validation, anomaly injection and file exports. This documents the local generator workflow; classroom users begin with the published files.
    S[Load Settings]
    C[Initialize GenerationContext]
    E[Create Empty Tables]
    M[Generate Master Data, BOMs, Routings, and Calendar]
    B[Generate Opening Balances and Budgets]
    O[Generate O2C, P2P, Manufacturing, Payroll, and Labor Activity]
    J[Generate Recurring Journals and Accrual Activity]
    P[Post Events to GLEntry]
    Y[Generate Year-End Close Journals]
    V[Run Validations]
    A[Inject Anomalies]
    X[Export SQLite, Excel, Curated Reports, CSV Zip, and Log]

    S --> C --> E --> M --> B --> O --> J --> P --> Y --> V --> A --> X
